authScheme: First-run wizard: POST /Startup/Configuration, POST /Startup/User {Name,Password}, POST /Startup/RemoteAccess, POST /Startup/Complete (no auth needed before completion; each answers 204 No Content). Afterwards every request needs an API key in the 'X-Emby-Token' header. To mint one: POST /Users/AuthenticateByName {Username, Pw} MUST carry the client-identification header Authorization: MediaBrowser Client="Miro", Device="miro", DeviceId="miro", Version="1" (no Token — it returns 400 without this header); the response's AccessToken is a session token usable as X-Emby-Token — keep it with storeResponseField {field:"AccessToken", ref:"extension.jellyfin.session_token"}. A permanent key: POST /Auth/Keys?app=Miro with that token (204), then GET /Auth/Keys lists Items[].AccessToken. Libraries: GET/POST /Library/VirtualFolders; sessions: GET /Sessions; system: GET /System/Info.
